head: b308030a737e2b705a0bde2ba6b2e1cec0f1f390
body:
Based on PR #15. Review only the incremental diff. Roc core code and regression tests only.

Filtering all input columns copied columns needed only by the predicate. Add optional retained-column selection to FilterOperator and FilterExec: evaluate the predicate against the complete input, select retained columns, then filter their rows. Callers supply output-column indices explicitly and bind downstream expressions to the compact schema. The default preserves existing output behavior; computed projections still evaluate after row selection.

PR #9 is deferred and closed. Its NULL-density dispatch and integer SUM first-value specialization are absent from this head. Grouped SUM and COUNT use the main implementation. No fresh performance measurement is claimed for the amended later revisions; historical samples retain their measured identities. DataFusion integration remains local.

Validation after removing PR #11: every remaining core head passed all-target compilation, final core passed 130 release tests, and the local-only DataFusion workspace passed 146. Scan polling equals main; all remaining incremental PR diffs are preserved. Historical timing samples keep their measured identities; no timings were collected for the post-removal stack.

[Performance report](https://github.com/ZENOTME/Roc/blob/2eec23b8dd0bf207135b16371f3b2e4f1ba9fd44/benches/optimization/logical-plan/README.md); [current source identities](https://github.com/ZENOTME/Roc/blob/2eec23b8dd0bf207135b16371f3b2e4f1ba9fd44/benches/optimization/logical-plan/core-source-verification.json).

PR #11 is deferred and closed: the isolated ready-channel measurement saved about 23 ns per batch without a demonstrated material SQL-query gain. Its manual polling change is absent from this head; retain main's simpler select_biased implementation. The exact measured source snapshots and all 360 samples remain historical evidence in the report.

head: 07919a785169557521d188860ee2c78f50b3a62d
body:
Based on PR #12. Review only the incremental diff. Roc core code and regression tests only.

Global SUM read and wrote its sole value and validity slots for every contributor. Keep total and validity in local variables and commit once per batch, including the successful prefix on checked integer overflow. Preserve NULL handling, sliced bitmap offsets, first-value semantics and floating input order. Use the ordinary valid_indices iteration for nullable input; do not select loops by NULL density or specialize integer first-value handling. Supply the explicit global route and argument preparation required by this optimization. COUNT, AVG and other aggregates retain ordinary grouped per-row updates.
